models.plamo08.headline: Fast responses with less memory
models.plamo08.description: A 0.57 GB model suited to fast translation of short game dialogue and subtitles. Supports 53 languages, including Korean, English and Japanese.
models.plamo08.hardwareGuide: The launcher converts requests that include source and target languages. For direct requests, specify the output language with target_lang.
models.plamo08.memoryGuide: Memory depends on context and GPU offload.
models.plamo08.benefit2: Detects the source language when you specify the target
models.plamo2.headline: For closer attention to wording and meaning
models.plamo2.description: A 1.81 GB model for prioritizing translation quality, with more memory use and processing time than 0.8B. Supports 53 languages, including Korean, English and Japanese.
models.plamo2.hardwareGuide: The launcher converts requests that include source and target languages. For direct requests, specify the output language with target_lang.
models.plamo2.memoryGuide: Memory depends on context and GPU offload.
models.plamo2.benefit2: Detects the source language when you specify the target
models.e2b.headline: Lightweight, fast translation
models.e2b.description: A lightweight translation model for game dialogue and subtitles. Natural translations that take the conversation and tone into account.
models.e2b.hardwareGuide: Start here if you want a lighter load on your PC.
models.e2b.benefit1: Tuned for dialogue and subtitle translation
models.e2b.benefit2: Memory optimization that reads only the needed data from SSD
models.e4b.headline: Translation that captures the nuance
models.e4b.description: A dedicated translation model focused on conversation flow and subtle meaning. Choose it when translation quality comes first, from subtitles to longer dialogue.
models.e4b.hardwareGuide: Recommended when you have graphics memory to spare.
models.e4b.benefit1: Translation that preserves context and tone
models.e4b.benefit2: Memory optimization that reads only the needed data from SSD
models.12b.headline: Expressive writing, personal conversations
models.12b.description: From translation to writing, roleplay, and natural, humanlike conversations. A versatile creative model combining uncensored tuning with distinctive style tuning.
models.12b.hardwareGuide: For broad creative work and conversations on a capable PC.
models.12b.benefit2: Style tuning that gives your writing a personality
models.hy18.headline: Lightweight, fast translation
models.hy18.description: A compact multilingual translation model for quick everyday translations with a lower memory footprint.
models.hy18.hardwareGuide: Choose it for responsiveness and a lighter load on your PC.
models.hy18.memoryGuide: Actual RAM and VRAM usage is shown while running.
models.hy18.benefit2: Use your own translation instructions and terminology
models.hy7.headline: Translation with attention to context
models.hy7.description: A larger multilingual translation model for complex sentences and context, when accuracy and expression matter most.
models.hy7.hardwareGuide: Choose it when translation quality matters more than memory use.
models.hy7.memoryGuide: Actual RAM and VRAM usage is shown while running.
models.hy7.benefit1: A larger model for quality-focused translation
models.hy7.benefit2: Use your own translation instructions and terminology
models.anis.name: ANIS Trans (Japanese only)
models.anis.headline: Translation for Japanese and Korean games
models.anis.description: A specialized Japanese ↔ Korean translation model by ANIS. First download requires official access approval.
models.anis.hardwareGuide: CPU supported; NVIDIA CUDA is optional with automatic CPU fallback.
models.anis.benefit1: Loads the model and exposes an OpenAI-compatible API
models.anis.benefit2: Official upstream program; no separate translation GUI
